reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Costume Parade Rain Plan 023
materials.text: Our costume parade moves indoors because of rain. Walk down the hall in pairs. Leave large umbrellas at the entrance. Tall paper hats must come off under the low doorway. The photo stop is beside the blue curtain. Return borrowed capes to the red rail after the parade.

questions.prompt: A friend waits outside in the rain for the parade. You say, "____"
options: Come inside; we walk in the hall.
The parade is in the swimming pool.
questions.explanation: A因雨改室内礼堂走廊；B独留雨中、C泳池均非新安排。

questions.prompt: A friend carries an open large umbrella into the line. You say, "____"
options: Hide it under a cape while open.
questions.explanation: B大伞门口留；A更多、C藏打开伞均不合。

questions.prompt: A tall paper hat hits the low doorway. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C低门取高帽；A硬挤、B缩门不解决。

questions.prompt: A friend asks where to stop for the photo. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A蓝幕旁拍照；B外面伞处、C红杆收披风非拍照点。

questions.prompt: A friend finishes and starts taking a borrowed cape home. You say, "____"
options: Return it to the red rail.
Leave it on the wet ground.
questions.explanation: B借披风红杆归还；A私留、C湿地丢放均非归位。

units.title: 野餐准备时礼貌地问清楚

materials.title: Picnic Missing Name Request 023
materials.text: Choose a helpful sentence for each picnic preparation problem. Each question gives the child’s full need.

questions.prompt: You see two identical bags and do not know which is yours. What do you ask?
options: Which bag has my name on it?
Do you like the blue sky?
questions.explanation: A用姓名区分同样袋子；B天空喜好、C树高不确认物主。

questions.prompt: You cannot open your water bottle. You ask an adult for help. What do you say?
options: I will throw it away now.
Could you help me open this bottle?
questions.explanation: B明确求助开瓶；A丢弃未求助；C唱歌能力无关。

questions.prompt: You have no seat and see a free space. You want permission to sit. What do you say?
questions.explanation: C请求使用空位；A草色、B见云不表达许可需求。

questions.prompt: Your friend is carrying too many cups. You offer to take some. What do you say?
options: Shall I carry some cups for you?
questions.explanation: A主动分担杯子；B加负担与意图相反；C无关比较不帮助。

questions.prompt: You spill water on a friend’s mat and want to apologise. What do you say?
options: It is your fault for sitting there.
I am sorry. I spilled water on your mat.
questions.explanation: B认自己泼水并道歉；A责怪对方、C偏好陈述均不道歉。

units.title: 校园早晨的十个完整句子

materials.title: School Morning Sentence Set 023
materials.text: Choose the word that completes each short school situation. Read the whole sentence in the question; each item is a complete situation.

questions.prompt: Our window ____ open. I can hear birds outside.
questions.explanation: A window单数用is；B am只配I；C are不配本句单数window。

questions.prompt: My sister is behind the curtain. ____ is hiding.
questions.explanation: B sister为女性人称She；A He不指sister；C It不用于本句已知女孩。

questions.prompt: I have two new ____. They are both sharp.
questions.explanation: C two要求pencils标准复数；A单数；B拼写错误。

questions.prompt: This bag belongs to Dad. It is ____ bag.
questions.explanation: A Dad为单数男性用his；B her不符Dad；C their复数或不定泛指非本句已明确Dad。

questions.prompt: There ____ three rulers on our table.
questions.explanation: B three rulers复数用are；A单数、C只配I不合。

questions.prompt: I put the ball inside the box. Now it is ____ the box.
questions.explanation: C in对应inside；A在上、B在下与已给内置动作不符。

questions.prompt: I want an apple. Please give me ____ apple from the bowl.
questions.explanation: A apple元音开头单数用an；B a不合元音冠词；C two后需apples且意愿一只。

questions.prompt: We are in music class. Let us ____ a song.
questions.explanation: B let us后动词原形sing；A单三、C分词均不合。

questions.prompt: These school ____ are yellow. We ride in them.
questions.explanation: C these要求buses标准复数；A单数；B错误复数写法。

questions.prompt: I ____ a clean cup. May I have some water?
questions.explanation: A I后用have作现在谓语；B has单三不配I；C having缺be不能独立谓语。

units.title: 社团日的五个实际问句

materials.title: Club Day Practical Questions 023
materials.text:
Match the five questions with their replies. Use each bank reply once.
A. No, the paint is still wet.
B. At the desk beside the stairs.
C. Two, one for each hand.
D. Because the room is too noisy.
E. The one with your name inside.

questions.prompt: May I touch our painted sign now?
options: No, the paint is still wet.
At the desk beside the stairs.
Because the room is too noisy.
The one with your name inside.
questions.explanation: A因漆湿拒触，答许可；B地点、C数量、D换房噪声原因、E物主辨认均不答此许可。

questions.prompt: Where can we collect the club cards?
options: No, the paint is still wet.
At the desk beside the stairs.
Because the room is too noisy.
The one with your name inside.
questions.explanation: B楼梯旁桌给领取地点；A触画许可、C数量、D噪声原因、E哪一件均不答Where。

questions.prompt: How many gloves do I need?
options: No, the paint is still wet.
At the desk beside the stairs.
Because the room is too noisy.
The one with your name inside.
questions.explanation: C两只各手一只答数量；A许可、B地点、D原因、E具名物均不答手套数。

questions.prompt: Why are we moving the reading game to another room?
options: No, the paint is still wet.
At the desk beside the stairs.
Because the room is too noisy.
The one with your name inside.
questions.explanation: D太吵解释换室原因；A漆湿非阅读游戏噪声问题；B桌位、C数量、E物主均不答Why。

questions.prompt: Which coat should I take from the rack?
options: No, the paint is still wet.
At the desk beside the stairs.
Because the room is too noisy.
The one with your name inside.
questions.explanation: E取内有自己名的外套；A许可、B桌位、C数量、D换室原因不能判哪外套。

materials.title: Garden Scarecrow Coat 023
materials.text: I see someone in Grandpa’s old coat in the garden. I wave, but the person does not move. I call Grandpa. He answers from the kitchen behind me. Then I laugh. The coat is on a scarecrow with a bucket hat. Grandpa made it this morning. He asks me to draw a smile on its cloth face. I use a black pen and give it a big smile.

questions.prompt: The figure in the garden wears Grandpa’s old coat.
questions.explanation: A正确：old coat在园中人形；B否认服饰线索。

questions.prompt: Grandpa is inside the coat when the writer first waves.
questions.explanation: B正确：爷爷从身后厨房答，衣在稻草人上；A误认当事实。

questions.prompt: The scarecrow has a bucket hat.
questions.explanation: A正确：bucket hat；B否认道具。

questions.prompt: Grandpa made the scarecrow the night before.
questions.explanation: B正确：this morning；A前夜错误时间。

questions.prompt: The writer draws a smile with a black pen.
questions.explanation: A正确：black pen big smile；B否认参与方式。

materials.title: Basket Market Kindness 023
materials.text: Kai takes a basket to buy three oranges for his aunt. At the market, an old man drops some apples. Kai puts his empty basket down and helps him pick them up. When he turns back, the orange seller has put three oranges in the basket. Kai thinks the seller is giving them away. She smiles and points to his aunt, who has just arrived and paid for them. Kai thanks both of them. He carries the oranges home and tells his aunt that the empty basket helped him keep his hands free to help.

questions.prompt: What does Kai go to buy?
questions.explanation: A为姨姑买三橙；B苹果属老人；C篮是自带。

questions.prompt: Why does Kai put his basket down?
options: To help pick up dropped apples.
questions.explanation: B腾手帮老人捡苹果；A卖篮、C赶车无据。

questions.prompt: Who pays for the oranges?
questions.explanation: C姨姑已付；A老人非付款人；B非赠送。

questions.prompt: What does Kai first misunderstand?
options: He thinks the oranges are a gift from the seller.
He thinks the basket contains no fruit at the end.
He thinks his aunt is at home.
questions.explanation: A看见橙误以卖者送；B篮有三橙；C虽未立刻见姨姑，未写以为在家。

questions.prompt: What is Kai glad the empty basket allowed him to do?
options: Carry the old man’s whole stall.
Keep his hands free to help.
questions.explanation: B放下空篮腾手帮忙；A整摊、C不买果非结尾收获。

materials.title: Class Bell Recording 023
materials.text: Our drama group practises a school scene. The scene needs a bell sound. We record the real school bell once and use the recording during rehearsal. A pupil hears it from the open music-room door and thinks lunch has started early. Our teacher puts a notice outside: "Drama practice: recorded bell." We also close the door during each short test. The real lunch bell still rings at twelve. We stop rehearsal then and go to eat with everyone else.

questions.prompt: The drama scene uses a recording of a bell.
questions.explanation: A正确：record real bell用排练；B否认声音来源。

questions.prompt: The first recorded bell means the real lunch time has changed.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅戏剧声，午饭仍十二；A把录音当真实时刻信号。

questions.prompt: A notice explains the rehearsal sound.
questions.explanation: A正确：门外Drama practice recorded bell；B否认解释。

questions.prompt: The class rehearses through the real lunch bell and never eats.
questions.explanation: B正确：真实十二铃后停排练去吃；A忽略最后动作。

questions.prompt: The door is closed during each short sound test.
questions.explanation: A正确：close door each short test；B否认减少误听的措施。

units.title: 河边清理活动的签名表

materials.title: River Picnic Cleanup Table 023
materials.text: At the river cleanup, helpers sign two lists. The first shows who has arrived. The second shows who has returned tools at the end. Mia signs the first list when she comes at nine. After collecting litter, she puts her grabber in the tool box. A leader checks it and asks her to sign the second list. Her friend wants to sign both lists at the start to save time. Mia explains that the second signature means the tool has actually come back, not just that she plans to return it.

questions.prompt: There is one list for arrival and another for tool return.
questions.explanation: A正确：两表分别抵达和归还；B否认功能区分。

questions.prompt: Mia signs the tool-return list before starting work.
questions.explanation: B正确：回收工具经查后才签第二表；A把朋友建议当她行动。

questions.prompt: A leader checks the returned grabber.
questions.explanation: A正确：leader checks it；B否认确认步骤。

questions.prompt: Signing both lists at the start would accurately record a completed return.
questions.explanation: B正确：未归不能记已归，文本明确not just plans；A把计划当已完成。

questions.prompt: The second signature records something that has happened.
questions.explanation: A正确：tool actually come back；B把已发生错误说成未来意图。

materials.title: Pool Family Session Table 023
materials.text:
Weekend pool sessions
Saturday 9:00–10:00: beginner lesson, pupils aged 8–11, booking required. A teacher leads the session.
Saturday 10:30–12:00: family swim, children with an accompanying adult, booking recommended.
Sunday 9:00–11:00: public swim, all permitted ages, no lessons provided.
A coloured wristband shows the session booked, not the swimmer’s skill. Do not enter before your session starts. All swimmers must follow the lifeguard’s instructions. The small pool closes ten minutes before the main pool for cleaning. If a session is cancelled, booked visitors receive a message; an unused wristband does not guarantee entry to a different session.

questions.prompt: Which session includes a beginner teacher?
questions.explanation: C周六九至十初学课有教师；A周日无课程；B家庭游无老师课程说明；D全有不符。

questions.prompt: What must a child have for the family swim?
questions.explanation: A家长或成人陪同；B证书、C船、D两带均非要求。

questions.prompt: What does a wristband identify?
questions.explanation: B标预约场次非技能；A速度、C成绩、D住址均不表示。

questions.prompt: When does the small pool close?
options: Ten minutes after the main pool.
At the same moment as every lesson starts.
Ten minutes before the main pool.
questions.explanation: D提前十分钟清洁；A先后反；B/C无此规则。

questions.prompt: What does an unused band from a cancelled session allow?
options: No automatic entry to another session.
questions.explanation: A明确不保证另场入；B/C/D均夸大权利与规则相反。

materials.title: Tiny Postbox Garden Story 023
materials.text: Our neighbour built a tiny postbox beside her gate. It was not for the post office. A note invited children to leave short drawings or questions about the garden. I asked why one bed had no flowers. A week later, a small reply explained that the bed was resting while new soil was prepared. She included a drawing of the flowers planned for spring. I had thought the empty bed meant nobody cared for it. The reply showed that quiet preparation could be part of gardening too. I kept the note and later drew a picture when the first shoots appeared.

questions.prompt: The tiny box was an official post-office collection point.
questions.explanation: B正确：not for post office；A把邻里互动箱当官方邮点。

questions.prompt: Children were invited to leave drawings or questions.
questions.explanation: A正确：note invited both；B否认用途。

questions.prompt: The empty bed had been forgotten with no plan.
questions.explanation: B正确：准备新土休整并有春花图；A重复作者误猜。

questions.prompt: The neighbour answered with an explanation and drawing.
questions.explanation: A正确：reply bed rest soil加planned flowers drawing；B否认回复方式。

questions.prompt: The writer later drew the new shoots.
questions.explanation: A正确：later drew picture first shoots；B否认后续参与。

units.title: 修复老照片时补出的颜色

materials.title: Photo Restoration Colours 023
materials.text:
The media club cleaned scratches from a scanned photograph of the school’s first sports day. A software tool also offered to add colour automatically. The result looked lively: blue shirts, a green tent and a red banner. Some pupils wanted to place it in the archive as a record of the original colours.
The archive keeper asked what evidence supported those choices. The black-and-white photograph could show shapes and light, but not prove every colour. A surviving cloth badge gave evidence for the banner design, yet it did not confirm the tent or shirts. The pupils kept the cleaned black-and-white scan as the reference version. They displayed the colour version separately with a note saying that several colours were guesses made by software.
A visitor enjoyed the coloured picture more. The club did not argue with that preference. It simply kept enjoyment separate from the claim that every added detail was historically established.

questions.prompt: What was uncertain about the automatic colour version?
options: Whether each added colour matched the past.
Whether the school had ever existed.
Whether a scan could be displayed.
questions.explanation: B自动补色无逐项历史依据；A有形状；C学校存在；D能展示。

questions.prompt: What evidence did the cloth badge provide?
options: The exact colour of every shirt.
Some support for the banner design.
questions.explanation: C徽章支持横幅设计；A/C之外衣色、B帐高、D软件设置均未证。

questions.prompt: Which version was kept as the reference?
questions.explanation: A黑白修痕扫描作基准；B非只彩；C无新画作基准；D确有留档。

questions.prompt: How was the coloured version presented?
options: As proof that every colour was correct.
questions.explanation: D分展注明软件猜色；A全真错误；B注明软件；C原版留参考。

questions.prompt: What distinction does the ending make?
options: Preference for an image is different from proof of its details.
Visitors must like black and white best.
questions.explanation: B喜欢彩版不等于其细节确证；A否全无用、C否全不可能、D强迫喜好均非结论。

units.title: 博物馆出游表上的第一选择

materials.title: School Trip Preference Form 023
materials.text:
The year group asked pupils to rank three possible museums for a trip. Most first choices went to the science museum. However, the booking office could offer only a date during exam week. The history museum had fewer first choices but a suitable date and enough spaces. The teacher explained the constraint before making a decision.
A few pupils said the vote had been ignored. The teacher showed the results and the booking information side by side. The preferences had informed the search, but they had not promised that every practical condition would be available. The group chose the history museum and planned a small science-club visit later for pupils who wanted it. The final note stated both the preference result and the reason for the actual trip.

questions.prompt: The science museum received the most first choices.
questions.explanation: A正确：most first choices science；B否认投票结果。

questions.prompt: Its available date was suitable for the year group.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅考试周可订，不适合；A忽略考试约束。

questions.prompt: The history museum had a suitable date and enough spaces.
questions.explanation: A正确：suitable date enough spaces；B否认现实可行条件。

questions.prompt: The teacher hid the preference results after choosing history.
questions.explanation: B正确：展示偏好与订票资料并列，终通知也写；A将解释说成隐瞒。

questions.prompt: The final decision reflected practical conditions as well as preferences.
questions.explanation: A正确：偏好引导但日期容量限制决定实旅；B把投票唯一化不符。
